responsibility: This generator produces insn-attr.h, the public target-attribute interface derived from machine description DEFINE_ATTR, DEFINE_ENUM_ATTR, DEFINE_DELAY, and DEFINE_INSN_RESERVATION forms. It declares get_attr_* accessors, special length-related helpers such as shorten_branches and insn_current_length, delay-slot eligibility hooks, and the DFA scheduling API used by the scheduler and hazard recognizer; it also analyzes constant attributes and reservation conditions to decide how much tuning-specific DFA entry state must be exposed.
